visualCharacteristics.structure: background photo + heading + frosted quote card + product mini-card

contentPattern: Row 1 = background image (cell 1 desktop crop, optional cell 2 mobile crop); row 2 = heading (h3); row 3 = quote paragraph(s), last paragraph (or a second cell) = attribution; row 4 = product: cell 1 thumbnail image, cell 2 product name + price + bold Buy link. Rows are recognised by content, so order is flexible and any row may be omitted.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single creator/customer testimonial over a full-bleed lifestyle photo, optionally paired with a buyable product. For quotes without a background photo or product, prefer default content or a plain quote block.
